title: Outline of Coverage: Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies, Cost Sharing Covered by Each Plan Letter
content:
Each policy sold under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies is one of the standardised plan letters, and the letter it carries fixes the share of the Medicare cost sharing the policy pays. The shares below are the whole of what each letter covers; a benefit shown as not covered is paid at nothing by that letter.

| Policy | Plan letter | Part A hospital coinsurance | Part A inpatient deductible | Part B coinsurance | Part B annual deductible | Part B excess charges | Skilled nursing facility coinsurance | Part A hospice coinsurance | First three pints of blood |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | A | 100 per cent | 0 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | not covered | 0 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | B | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | not covered | 0 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | D | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | not covered | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | K | 100 per cent | 50 per cent | 50 per cent | not covered | not covered | 50 per cent | 50 per cent | 50 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | N | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | not covered | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | G | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | covered | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | High Deductible G | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | not covered | covered | 100 per cent | 100 per cent | 100 per cent |

### Points of judgement on the schedule

The Part A hospital coinsurance stands at 100 per cent on every letter sold, so the letter a policyholder holds never changes that share. The Part A inpatient deductible separates the letters: Plan A pays 0 per cent of it, Plan K pays 50 per cent, and every other letter pays it in full.

No letter sold under this product pays the annual Part B deductible. Charges above the Medicare approved amount, which arise only from a provider who does not accept Medicare assignment, are paid only under Plan G and High Deductible Plan G.

Plan K is the one letter that pays a half share across the Part A inpatient deductible, the Part B coinsurance, skilled nursing facility coinsurance, hospice coinsurance and the first three pints of blood. Skilled nursing facility coinsurance is paid at 0 per cent under Plan A and Plan B, so a skilled nursing line on either of those letters leaves that coinsurance entirely with the policyholder.
